facilities.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/motorized-roadside-camping ('There are no modern conveniences on state forest lands such as dump stations, utility hook-ups, showers, or water') + https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880251&siteId=23623 ('Campers are advised to bring their own water'; 'All campsites are carry in, carry out'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Open year round on the booking site; state forest roads are not plowed, so winter access is not guaranteed.

season.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880251&siteId=23623 ('Status: Open year round') + https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-forests/find-a-forest/delaware/camping ('State forest roads do not receive winter maintenance and are not plowed --motorized, roadside camping access is not guaranteed'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: A permit and reservation are always required, on the Pennsylvania State Parks and Forests reservation site or 888-PA-PARKS. Check-in and check-out 3 pm; campers must vacate for at least 48 hours before returning.

booking.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-forests/find-a-forest/delaware/camping ('A permit and reservation is always required for motorized, roadside camping', 'may be reserved up to eleven months in advance', 'Stays are limited to seven nights at a motorized, roadside campsite', 'Campers must vacate for at least 48 hours before returning') + https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/motorized-roadside-camping ('reserved 11 months in advance to noon of the day of arrival') + https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880251&siteId=23623 ('Site Reserve Type: Site-Specific', 'Checkin Time: 3:00 pm'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: A single roadside site, S001 Snow Hill (Snow Hill loop), on Laurel Run Road about 2.8 miles north of PA 447 (1 mile south of Snow Hill Road). Back-in, max vehicle length 40 ft; site 110 x 40 ft, gravel driveway at a slight grade, shaded, 15-ft overhead clearance.

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880251&siteId=23623 ('Max Vehicle Length: 40', 'Driveway Entry: Back-In', 'Driveway Surface: Gravel', 'Site Length: 110', 'Site Width: 40', 'Shade: Shaded', 'located along Laurel Run Road, approximately 2.8 miles north of PA447 or about 1 mile south of Snow Hill Road'), read 2026-10-20

note: Delaware State Forest motorized roadside site S001 (Snow Hill area) in wooded upland on Laurel Run Road, about 2.8 miles north of PA 447. One shaded back-in site for vehicles up to 40 ft on a gravel driveway. No water, hookups, toilets or trash service (carry in, carry out). Permit and reservation always required; district office 570-895-4000. --Claude
summary: Confirmed reservable on ReserveAmerica 11 months ahead to noon, 7-night limit. Added no hookups/water/dump/showers, a single back-in roadside site with a 40-ft max vehicle length, reservation always required (fcfs never), open year round. Note corrected: a designated roadside site, not dispersed. Fees left at the DCNR state forest rate.
